name: goatcode-sh
description: Enterprise-grade OpenCode plugin with micro-plugin architecture, multi-agent orchestration, and professional naming

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm --external zod --external @opencode-ai/plugin && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.test: bun test './src/features/background-agent/manager.test.ts' './src/tools/background-task/end-to-end.integration.test.ts' && find ./src -name '*.test.ts' ! -path './src/features/background-agent/manager.test.ts' ! -path './src/tools/background-task/end-to-end.integration.test.ts' -print0 | xargs -0 bun test
scripts.test:eval: cd eval && bunx promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml
scripts.eval:suite: cd eval && PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 bunx promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml -o artifacts/results/latest.json --max-concurrency 1 --no-cache
scripts.test:ablation: cd eval && bunx promptfoo eval -c ablation-config.yaml
